name: vendor.openwop-app.workflows.cms
description: CMS content workflows (RFC 0013 / ADR 0204 C6) — chains over the feature.cms.nodes governed verbs. `cms.localize-and-submit` translates ONE draft section into a target locale and submits the page for editorial review: read the draft section, AI-translate its base data (structure-preserving), store the overlay on the draft (sanitized like an editor save), then submit — the SAME approval-gate composition as the editor UI, so when `cms-approval-gate` is ON the run ends at a human ApprovalsInbox row. There is deliberately NO publish step: a node can draft and submit, never publish (the Phase-C architecture ruling). All tenant/org/page values are run parameters (replay-deterministic).
author: OpenWOP App

chains.label: Localize a draft section & submit for review
chains.description: Translate one section of a DRAFT CMS page into a target locale and submit the page for editorial review. The overlay is drafted by AI (structure-preserving — URLs, media tokens, and {{vars}} are never translated), stored through the same sanitized write path as an editor save, and the submit queues a human approval when the org gates publishing. Nothing is published by this chain.

orgId.description: The org that owns the page.

sectionId.description: The section whose base data is translated.

submitted.description: Whether the page reached in_review (awaiting a human — a review row is queued under both toggle states).
